acceptable_use_policy: Data is used for law enforcement purposes only. Data is owned by Casa Grande AZ PD and is never sold to 3rd parties.
prohibited_uses: Immigration enforcement, traffic enforcement, harassment or intimidation, usage based solely on a protected class (i.e. race, sex, religion), Personal use.
access_policy: All system access requires a valid reason and is stored indefinitely.
hotlist_policy: Hotlist hits are required to be human verified prior to action.
overview: Casa Grande AZ PD uses Flock Safety LPR Technology to capture objective evidence without compromising on individual privacy. Casa Grande AZ PD utilizes retroactive search to solve crimes after they've occurred. Additionally, Casa Grande AZ PD utilizes real time alerting of hotlist vehicles to capture wanted criminals. In an effort to ensure proper usage and guardrails are in place, they have made the below policies and usage statistics available to the public.
success_stories:
The Casa Grande Police Department is committed to transparency, accountability, and the responsible use of technology. The Safe City Success Stories below provide real-world examples of how our Real Time Information Center (RTIC) and Flock Safety technologies are used to support investigations, locate missing persons, enhance officer safety, and protect our community. This section is updated regularly and displays recent activity to demonstrate the measurable impact of the Safe City Initiative.

These examples represent only a small snapshot of RTIC activity and outcomes and are not a comprehensive list of all cases or incidents where Safe City technology has assisted. Many uses occur daily and may not be included due to investigative sensitivity, case status, or the routine nature of the assistance provided.
